study_identification_part.si_4_title: Lifespan development of thalamic nuclei and characterizing thalamic nuclei abnormalities in schizophrenia using normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: HCP Development, HCP S1200 (young adult), and HCP Aging datasets formed the HCP Lifespan normative reference; a single-location schizophrenia cohort was used for application.
